description: Functional test cases for Swaraj Saathi — validates core user flows without exposing internal architecture

test_cases.description: User files a water supply complaint entirely through chat (Hindi)
test_cases.expected: AI guides the user step-by-step and returns a confirmation receipt with ticket ID

test_cases.description: User files a complaint in Marathi
test_cases.expected: AI guides the user step-by-step in Marathi and returns a confirmation receipt

test_cases.description: Rural female farmer asks for relevant schemes
test_cases.input: मी एक शेतकरी आहे, मला कोणत्या योजना मिळतील?
test_cases.expected: AI recommends matching schemes (PM-KISAN, Lek Ladki, MJPJAY) based on profile

test_cases.description: SC category student in urban Maharashtra
test_cases.expected: Matches scholarship schemes like Dr. Ambedkar Swadhar Yojana

test_cases.description: System handles English, Hindi, and Marathi inputs correctly
inputs: I want to apply for a housing scheme
मुझे आवास योजना के लिए अप्लाई करना है
मला घरकुल योजनेसाठी अर्ज करायचा आहे
test_cases.expected: All three inputs are understood and routed to the same scheme application flow

test_cases.description: No citizen data leaves the local server during AI inference
test_cases.validation: Network traffic monitoring confirms zero outbound calls to third-party LLM providers
